skill_name: Describe the composition of the human eye
workflow: The human eye consists of the cornea, pupil, lens, retina, and aqueous and vitreous humour. The cornea is the transparent dome at the front of the eye. It helps the eye to focus light rays onto the pupil. The pupil is the dark opening in the center of the eye, allowing light to pass through. The lens is behind the pupil and helps to focus light onto the back of the eye. The retina is a thin layer of light-sensitive cells lining the inner surface of the eye.
